public_body: Cambridge Public School Graham And Parks School Council
overall: The AG found the Council violated the Open Meeting Law by posting a September 17, 2025 notice with no discussion topics, found the violation intentional, and referred it for hearing with a recommended $500 fine.

allegations.summary: Threshold issue: complaint about a Sept 17, 2025 meeting was filed with the AG on Jan 19, 2026. The AG considered whether the delay was excusable.
allegations.key_passage: Upon careful consideration of those circumstances, we find that the complainant has demonstrated good cause for the delay, and we review her complaint.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Sept 17, 2025 meeting notice was insufficiently specific because it listed no discussion topics, while topics were discussed at the open meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The Council acknowledges, and we find, that the notice of the September 17 meeting did not satisfy the requirements of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the notice violation was intentional. The AG considered whether the Council knowingly violated the law given the prior OML 2025-85 determination.
allegations.key_passage: Because the violation at issue here is substantively the same as the one found in OML 2025-85, we find that it was intentional.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Referral for a hearing under 940 CMR 29.07(3), with a recommended $500 civil penalty under G.L. c. 30A, § 23(c).
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
